name: Pelso Black Sesame-Caramel Pulls
description: Long-pull taffy-style synth-chews with a roasted black sesame paste core suspended in a caramel-flavored synth-sugar shell. Each piece is individually wrapped in recyclable film.
flavor_profile: Nutty, slightly bitter sesame with a warm caramel sweetness; dense chew that softens with body heat, leaving a faint toasty aftertaste
slogan: Pull it apart. Find what's inside.
cultural_context: Marketed toward working-class commuters who want something substantial during long transit rides; the 'pull' ritual has become a minor social gesture — sharing a pull candy is considered a low-stakes act of friendliness on the mag-rail.
story_hooks: A batch of Pelso Pulls is found to contain an unlicensed mood-modulating compound — someone is using the supply chain to distribute unapproved bioactives to commuters.
The distinctive wrapper color is used as a dead-drop signal between two rival info-broker networks.
A Tier 2 worker becomes obsessed with recreating the sesame paste formula at home after the product is quietly discontinued.
